correctness.rationale: For f(x)=xᵀHx/2, each orthonormal-frame forward-difference estimator is Hx+e(U), e=(h/2)Σ_j(u_jᵀHu_j)u_j. Haar column-sign symmetry gives mean zero, and standard sixth-sphere moments give eigenbasis variance c_i from the displayed trace polynomial. For any pair with Haar marginals, Cauchy–Schwarz shows Var(a_i e0i+e1i)≥c_i(1−|a_i|)². The spectral reflector S commuting with H and having eigenvalues −sgn(a_i) attains all mode bounds simultaneously. Independent block noise gives even-time geometric variance and exact stationary objective for |a_i|<1. Independent analytic angular integration for d=2 checked mode moments and mixed-sign alignment.
residual_risks: Exact SPD quadratics, positive fixed h, independent i.i.d. pairs with Haar marginals, spectral stability 0<α<2/λmax, even-time risk.
